topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I sit back, the rain drumming a steady beat on the window. The city’s a labyrinth of secrets and shadows, and I’ve seen every trick, every shade of truth. So when the kid’s old teacher pops up again, teaching the next generation, it doesn’t surprise me much. Circles, that’s what life is. You think you’re moving forward, but you end up right where you started. The past has a way of catching up. I pour another cup of coffee, hot and strong, and watch the steam rise. Things change, but not as much as you’d think. The rain’s not letting up anytime soon, and neither are the echoes of the past.
